title: Biomedical Engineer
job_description:
About the role

As a Biomedical Engineer Lead at PT Ellipse Projects Indonesia, you will be responsible for the equipment specification, procurement, and coordination with project teams and clients to ensure proper integration of medical equipment within the overall facility design, particularly by providing technical review of vendor submissions, multidisciplinary coordination, support to installation, commissioning, and handover activities.

What you'll be doing:

Lead the technical evaluation and selection of medical equipment for procurement, ensuring compliance with project specifications, clinical requirements, and contractual agreements.

Collaborate with project teams, consultants, and clients to review equipment specifications and confirm alignment with contract scope and healthcare facility needs.

Coordinate with procurement and vendor representatives during the tendering and purchasing process, including technical clarification and product comparison.

Provide technical support during equipment planning, layout review, and integration within hospital infrastructure.

Work closely with technical and engineering teams to ensure proper installation of medical equipment in accordance with construction procedures, safety standards, and manufacturer requirements.

Conduct inspection and verification of delivered equipment to ensure compliance with approved specifications and project documentation.

Facilitate communication between stakeholders including contractors, suppliers, clinical users, and project management teams to ensure smooth implementation of medical equipment.

Qualifications:

Min. Bachelor’s degree of Electromedical, Medical Engineering, or related discipline.

5-7 years’ experience in relevant projects related to health technology and equipment (planning, procurement, and installation)

Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Knowledge, experience, and certification required:

Extensive medical equipment knowledge

Understanding of procurement & technical evaluation, hospital project integration, installation, and commissioning

Awareness of ISO 13485 & ISO 9001

Extensive knowledge of Indonesian MoH requirements and healthcare standards

Recognized biomedical engineering certification (advantageous)

Project management training or certification (advantageous)

Proficient in using engineering software, such as Autocad, project tools, and office tools

Professional in behaviour and communication and able to perform as a team leader.

What we offer

At PT Ellipse Projects Indonesia, we are committed to providing our employees with a rewarding and fulfilling work environment. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance and opportunities for professional development & career growth.

title: Senior .NET Full Stack Engineer (English Speaker)

About the role

Join our growing team at PT Artha Solutions Indonesia as a Senior .NET Full Stack Developer. In this key role, you will be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining high-performance web applications using the latest .NET technologies. As a senior member of the development team, you will play a pivotal part in shaping the technical direction of our products and mentoring more junior developers. Design and implement scalable, maintainable, and secure cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure.

Oversee the deployment, management, and operation of applications on Azure, ensuring optimal performance.

Collaborate with IT and development teams to plan and execute cloud strategies, providing guidance on Azure best practices.

Develop front-end applications, database development, and middle-tier services.

Implement DevOps practices, including continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

Ensure cloud solutions integrate seamlessly with existing systems and meet business requirements.

Monitor and optimize cloud solutions for performance efficiency.

8+ years of experience in developing enterprise-level web applications using .NET technologies

Proficient in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, and modern web frameworks such as Angular or React

Strong understanding of relational databases (SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cosmos DB)

Hands-on experience in designing and consuming RESTful APIs

Familiarity with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based hosting platforms

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with a sharp attention to detail

Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

Ability to mentor and guide more junior developers in the team

Must Have & Desired Skills: 

• In-depth knowledge of cloud computing concepts and Microsoft Azure services.
• Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as PowerShell, Python, and C#.
• Experience with Azure-specific services like Azure SQL Database, Azure DevOps, and Azure Active Directory, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, Function Apps, App Services, API Management.
• Strong understanding of DevOps principles and tools.
• Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards for cloud environments.
• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Continuous learning and skill upgradation to keep up with the dynamic nature of cloud technologies.

Desired Skills:
• Experience with front-end technologies and frameworks like Angular.
• Familiarity with agile and DevOps practices.
• Previous experience in a similar role within a fast-paced environment.

Education: Bachelor's degree in technology or equivalent.

title: QA/Test Engineer

About the role

Design, develop, and execute detailed and structured manual test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for both frontend (web/mobile applications) and backend (APIs, services, databases) systems.

Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and prioritise testing requirements and strategies.

Perform various types of manual testing including functional, regression, integration, smoke, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Identify, document, track, and manage defects with clear steps, evidence, and severity levels using bug tracking tools.

Validate bug fixes and perform regression testing to ensure resolution and prevent new issues.

Analysing test results and providing detailed reports to stakeholders.

Continuously researching and implementing best practices in software testing to enhance our quality assurance processes.

Mentoring and training junior team members to improve their testing skills and knowledge

What we're looking for

Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on manual testing.

Proven ability to design, write, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases from requirements and user stories.

Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Insomnia) and basic SQL knowledge for data validation.

Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders and team members.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field


About us

PT. Kredit Utama Fintech Indonesia is a leading financial technology company dedicated to providing innovative and user-friendly digital financial solutions. With a focus on customer-centricity, we strive to empower individuals and businesses by leveraging the latest technologies and industry expertise. Our mission is to democratise access to financial services and foster financial inclusion across Indonesia.

Apply now and become a part of our thriving team!

title: Back-End TypeScript Developer
job_description:
Ready To Build Something Real?

John Galt Services seeks a full-time Back-End TypeScript Developer to serve a US customer building a construction project management platform used by contractors across the United States.

This is a production SaaS product with real users and real money flowing through it: proposals, invoices, purchase orders, budgets, vendor payments. The back end is a NestJS API with over 100 domain modules, multi-tenant PostgreSQL with row-level security, background job processing, AI-powered features, and integrations with QuickBooks, Google Calendar, and e-signature providers.

You won't be maintaining a legacy codebase nobody cares about. You'll be shipping features that contractors rely on to run their businesses. The codebase is modern, the architecture is serious, and the problems are interesting.

You must be fluent in English. You will join our customer's development team as a remote member with real responsibilities: not busywork.

IMPORTANT!

Your application is our first test of your attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. 👀

👉 Read this ENTIRE job listing!

👉 Follow the application instructions EXACTLY!

👉 If you do not meet the minimum qualifications for the job, DO NOT APPLY!

If you fail to follow the instructions below, we will reject your application without reading it!

Minimum Job Qualifications

FLUENT SPOKEN & WRITTEN ENGLISH! You will communicate daily with a US-based team. Your English must be clear and confident — spoken and written. If you aren't sure, keep practicing and apply next time.

SOLID TYPESCRIPT SKILLS! You don't need to be a generics wizard yet, but you must understand and value type safety. If your instinct is to slap any on everything and "fix it later," this isn't the right fit.

EXPERIENCE WITH NestJS OR SIMILAR FRAMEWORKS! The back end is a NestJS API backed by PostgreSQL (TypeORM), with background job processing (BullMQ), JWT authentication, and Docker-based deployment. If the words "dependency injection" make you nervous, spend some time with the NestJS docs and then come back.

You won't be expected to know any of these on day one, but you'll be expected to dig in and figure things out. If you need someone looking over your shoulder at every step, this role will be frustrating for both of us.

A DISCIPLINED ENGINEERING APPROACH! You write tests. You read the requirements before you code. You don't push to main and pray. We don't expect perfection. We DO expect professionalism.

Docker & Docker Compose

PostgreSQL / TypeORM

REST API design & Swagger/OpenAPI

AWS (ECR, deployment pipelines)

OpenTelemetry / observability

Git & GitHub Actions

You are supporting our customer remotely, but this is NOT a remote job! We will provide working space and equipment near Canggu, Bali. All work is performed on-site.

New associates start at a probationary pay scale of IDR 8 jt / month gross (i.e. before taxes & benefits). Your probationary period is three months.

title: Quality Engineer
job_description:
Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Perencanaan dan Persiapan Mutu (Pre-Construction)

Menyusun RMK (Rencana Mutu Kontrak): Membuat dokumen rencana mutu proyek (Project Quality Plan) yang mengacu pada Spesifikasi Umum Bina Marga

Pembuatan JMF & JMD: Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pembuatan Job Mix Design (JMD) dan Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Approval Material: Mengajukan persetujuan sumber material (Quarry) kepada Konsultan Pengawas dan Owner (Dinas PU/Balai). Mengingat di Jayapura, memastikan kualitas aggregate dari quarry lokal atau material didatangkan dari luar (misal: Palu/Sulawesi) sesuai spek sangat vital.

Kalibrasi Alat: Memastikan seluruh peralatan laboratorium dan peralatan batching plant atau AMP (Asphalt Mixing Plant) sudah terkalibrasi dan layak pakai.

2. Pengendalian Material Masuk (Incoming Material Control)

Inspeksi Bahan Baku: Melakukan pengecekan rutin terhadap material yang masuk ke stockpile (aspal cair, semen, agregat kasar/halus).

Uji Kualitas Rutin: Melakukan tes abrasi, kelekatan aspal, berat jenis, dan gradasi secara berkala untuk memastikan material dari quarry tetap konsisten.

3. Pengendalian Proses di Lapangan (Process Control)

Persetujuan Izin Kerja (Request for Work): Memverifikasi kesiapan lapangan sebelum pekerjaan dimulai (cek kebersihan, tack coat/prime coat, kesiapan alat).

Monitoring Suhu & Hamparan: Mengawasi suhu aspal saat di AMP, saat tiba di lokasi (dump truck), dan saat penghamparan (laying) agar sesuai JMF.

Pengawasan Pemadatan: Memastikan jumlah passing (lintasan) alat berat sesuai dengan trial section yang sudah disepakati.

Drainase & Bahu Jalan: Memastikan mutu beton untuk saluran drainase dan material timbunan bahu jalan sesuai spesifikasi.

4. Pengujian dan Laboratorium (Testing & Lab)

Manajemen Laboratorium: Memimpin teknisi lab dalam pelaksanaan tes harian.

Pengujian Lapangan: Mengawasi pelaksanaan Sand Cone Test (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan aspal), dan tes ekstraksi aspal (kadar aspal).

Trial Section: Memimpin pelaksanaan percobaan penghamparan (trial) sebelum pekerjaan utama dimulai.

5. Administrasi dan Pelaporan (Documentation)

Laporan Harian & Bulanan: Menyusun laporan Quality Control (QC) harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.

Back-Up Data Quality: Menyusun kelengkapan data kualitas (hasil tes lab, foto dokumentasi, request) sebagai syarat penagihan termin (MC - Monthly Certificate).

Penanganan NCR (Non-Conformance Report): Jika ada pekerjaan yang tidak lulus tes (misal: aspal kurang tebal atau beton retak), QE wajib menganalisis penyebabnya dan mengusulkan metode perbaikan (corrective action) kepada Project Manager.




Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

Pendidikan: Minimal S1 Teknik Sipil, D3/D4 Sipil diperbolehkan jika memiliki pengalaman lapangan yang sangat kuat.

Sertifikasi Kompetensi (SKK/SKA): Wajib memiliki SKK (Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja) Konstruksi yang masih aktif.

Jenjang: Minimal Ahli Muda (Jenjang 7) atau Ahli Madya (Jenjang 8).

Bidang: Teknik Jalan atau Ahli Material Jalan.

Pengalaman Minimal 3–5 tahun pengalaman kerja di posisi yang relevan (Quality Control/Quality Engineer).

Diutamakan yang pernah menangani proyek Preservasi/Rehabilitasi Jalan

Kami mencari profesional QC & QA yang berdedikasi dan detail-oriented untuk bergabung dengan tim Quality Assurance kami di Bekasi, Jawa Barat. Sebagai QC & QA, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam memastikan bahwa setiap produk yang dihasilkan memenuhi standar kualitas tertinggi sebelum sampai ke tangan pelanggan. Posisi ini memerlukan keahlian dalam inspeksi produk, pengujian, dan pengendalian kualitas untuk menjaga konsistensi dan keandalan produk kami. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi full time yang berbasis di Bekasi, Jawa Barat, memungkinkan Anda untuk menjadi bagian integral dari operasi manufaktur kami yang dinamis.

Tanggung Jawab Utama


Melakukan inspeksi visual dan pengujian produk secara menyeluruh di berbagai tahap produksi untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan standar kualitas yang telah ditetapkan.

Mengidentifikasi produk dan ketidaksesuaian, serta mendokumentasikan temuan dengan laporan yang terperinci dan akurat.

Melakukan pengujian kualitas menggunakan peralatan standar industri dan metode pengujian yang telah ditentukan.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim produksi untuk mengimplementasikan tindakan perbaikan dan pencegahan (CAPA) guna mengurangi tingkat ke gagalan produk.

Memelihara dokumentasi lengkap hasil pengujian, laporan inspeksi, dan catatan kualitas sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan.

Melakukan audit internal untuk memverifikasi kepatuhan terhadap standar kualitas dan regulasi yang berlaku.

Memberikan rekomendasi untuk peningkatan proses dan efisiensi operasional berdasarkan data dan analisis kualitas.

Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain untuk memastikan penyelesaian masalah kualitas secara cepat dan efektif.




Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan


Pendidikan minimal Diploma (D3) dalam Teknik Industri, Teknik Mesin, atau bidang terkait; gelar Bachelor (S1) lebih diutamakan.

Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Quality Control dan Quality Assurance di industri manufaktur atau logistik.

Kemampuan mengoperasikan alat dan instrumen pengujian kualitas standar industri.

Keahlian dalam menggunakan Statistical Process Control (SPC) dan metode analisis data kualitas.

Penguasaan software Quality Management System dan Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).

Kemampuan analitik yang kuat dan attention to detail yang tinggi.

Keterampilan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tulisan, dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Kemampuan bekerja dalam tim dan memimpin inisiatif perbaikan kualitas.

Sertifikasi Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, atau sertifikasi kualitas lainnya merupakan keuntungan tambahan.




Manfaat Utama Perusahaan


Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kompetensi yang dimiliki.

Tunjangan kesehatan komprehensif termasuk asuransi kesehatan untuk Anda dan keluarga.

Program pensiun (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) yang terjamin sesuai dengan peraturan pemerintah.

Cuti tahunan yang generous, termasuk cuti sakit dan cuti khusus.

Peluang pengembangan karier dan pelatihan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi profesional.

Lingkungan kerja yang aman dan mendukung dengan perhatian terhadap kesehatan dan keselamatan kerja (K3).

Program insentif kinerja berbasis pencapaian target kualitas.

Kesempatan untuk terlibat dalam proyek-proyek peningkatan proses yang strategis.




Tentang Kami
Kami adalah perusahaan manufaktur terkemuka di industri logistik yang berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan produk berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami di seluruh dunia. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun dalam industri ini, kami telah membangun reputasi yang solid sebagai mitra terpercaya dalam rantai pasokan global. Perusahaan kami berdiri pada pilar-pilar nilai seperti integritas, inovasi, dan komitmen terhadap keunggulan operasional. Kami percaya bahwa kualitas adalah jantung dari kesuksesan bisnis kami, dan setiap anggota tim memiliki peran penting dalam mencapai visi ini. Budaya kerja kami mendorong kolaborasi, pembelajaran berkelanjutan, dan pengembangan profesional bagi setiap karyawan. Kami tidak hanya memproduksi produk; kami membangun kepercayaan dan hubungan jangka panjang dengan semua pemangku kepentingan kami.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda memiliki passion untuk kualitas dan ingin berkontribusi pada tim yang berdedikasi, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari perjalanan menuju keunggulan operasional dan inovasi berkelanjutan dalam industri manufaktur.

Company Description


Kata.ai is an Indonesian Conversational Artificial Intelligence company with a focus on creating technology to enhance the understanding of human conversations, improving the way humans collaborate with machines. Kata.ai’s Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology powers MultiPurpose chatbots (virtual customer service / virtual friend) for major corporations in Indonesia across different kinds of industries such as Unilever (FMCG), Telkomsel (Telco), Bank BRI (Financial Services), and Alfamart (Retail).

The company’s proprietary Kata Bot Platform can be leveraged to create feature-rich chatbots on top of Kata.ai’s robust and scalable AI technology platform, ensuring company of any size can easily build their own chatbot on any messaging platform. With this platform, it is now possible for the business to focus on designing engaging interaction for their customers, while Kata.ai handles all the technology aspects of the chatbots.

Established in 2015, the company has become a trusted partner for major corporations such as Microsoft, Accenture, and Line. In 2020, the company received Series-B funding from TransPacific Technology Fund and MDI Venture.

Job Description


You will be responsible for designing, building, implementing, and maintaining solutions and third-party integrations that work with Kata Platform for our partners. Yes, you will be building chat bots.

Qualifications


1-2 year experience with .NET / Spring / Laravel / Rails / NodeJS. (Fresh graduates with exceptional internship experience are welcome to apply!)
Familiarity with Javascript and standard JavaScript asynchronous patterns (Promise, async / await, callback, closures).
Strong CS fundamentals and OOP Knowledge.
Experience in Unit Testing or TDD.
Experience in SQL and NoSQL databases.
Experience in designing and developing RESTful API.
Familiarity with SOA / Microservice architecture.
Familiarity with Git.
Knows how to work in an agile environment.

Additional Information


To apply directly, you can click the following link: https://katrecs.kata.ai/?cp=kata.ai 

We value a flexible working hour for our employees.

The most important is we provide a learning experience in Conversational AI Industry.

title: Field IoT Engineer
job_description:
Posisi: Field IoT Engineer
Lokasi: Onsite (Jabodetabek/Cikarang/Karawang)
Jenis: Full-time (masa probation 3 bulan)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Posisi ini bertanggung jawab atas desain teknis, integrasi, dan validasi sistem IoT & inspeksi visual di lokasi pelanggan. Peran ini tetap bekerja di lapangan, namun fokus pada engineering decision, integrasi sistem, dan reliability, bukan sekadar pekerjaan fisik.

(Mohon disiapkan jawaban untuk semua poin di bawah ini pada saat interview)

Tanggung Jawab

Mendesain arsitektur sistem IoT & kamera inspeksi end-to-end di lingkungan industri (kamera, lighting, edge device, PLC, microcontroller, jaringan, panel box).

Menentukan spesifikasi teknis hardware (kamera, sensor, MCU, PLC, power, enclosure) sesuai kebutuhan sistem dan constraint site.

Merancang, merakit dan melakukan review panel box (layout, wiring, grounding, power distribution) sesuai standar keselamatan industri.

Melakukan instalasi hardware yang relevan di lapangan (panel box, kamera, lighting, mounting, bracket).

Mengintegrasikan microcontroller industri (Arduino, STM32 atau setara), sensor, PLC, dan edge device ke dalam satu sistem yang stabil.

Melakukan konfigurasi dan troubleshooting komunikasi industri (Modbus, OPC UA, TCP/IP, Ethernet/IP, serial communication).

Melakukan commissioning sistem: testing, kalibrasi, stress test, dan validasi performa sistem di site.

Berkoordinasi dengan tim software/AI untuk memastikan setup hardware mendukung performa dan reliabilitas sistem computer vision.

Membuat dokumentasi teknis tingkat engineering (arsitektur sistem, wiring diagram final, konfigurasi perangkat, failure analysis).

Menjadi representasi teknis saat diskusi teknis dengan customer (engineer-to-engineer discussion).


Kualifikasi

Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Elektro, Mekatronika, Teknik Informatika, atau setara.

Pengalaman minimal 2–5 tahun di bidang IoT / industrial automation / system integration.

Menguasai microcontroller industri (STM32 atau setara), sensor, dan dasar firmware/hardware integration.

Menguasai integrasi dan operasi PLC (Siemens, Omron, Mitsubishi, Allen-Bradley).

Memahami desain dan implementasi panel kontrol industri (power, relay, terminal, safety).

Memahami komunikasi industri dan networking (Modbus, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, TCP/IP).

Memahami kebutuhan sistem computer vision (lighting consistency, FOV, resolution, trigger, latency).

Mampu membaca, membuat, dan me-review wiring diagram serta layout sistem.

Terbiasa bekerja di lingkungan industri dan siap turun ke site.

Analitis, rapi, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu mengambil keputusan teknis di lapangan.

Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas dan bekerja di site pelanggan.


Keuntungan

Kesempatan menangani proyek industri berskala internasional.

Lingkungan kerja modern di bidang AI dan otomasi industri.

Pelatihan internal dan peluang pengembangan karier.


Nilai Tambah (Opsional)

Pengetahuan tentang sistem SCADA, IoT Gateway, atau integrasi cloud.

Sertifikasi terkait kelistrikan industri, PLC, atau safety (K3) menjadi nilai tambah.

Kemampuan dasar dalam scripting atau konfigurasi software integrasi (misalnya Node-RED, Python, atau C++).

Pengalaman 3D Modeling dan 3D Printing.

title: Staff Data Engineer (Managerial Level)
job_description:
About us:  

Populix is a consumer insights platform that helps businesses connect with its database of respondents and provides them with insights to better understand the preferences of Indonesian consumers. Populix has a pool of over 1,000,000 diverse, readily accessible, and highly qualified respondents across Indonesia. Its products range from intensive research studies to simple surveys and can be arranged on a project or subscription basis. Focusing on Indonesian consumers being super sticky to their phones, Populix facilitates a diverse range of data collection methods via its mobile app.

About the Role:


Populix is building the future of AI-powered market research, combining structured data, unstructured insights, and generative AI into a seamless research intelligence platform. As a Senior/Staff Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines and infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure high-quality, timely data powers business decisions across the organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will write production-grade code, architect data solutions, mentor team members, and drive best practices in data engineering, governance, and security.
 

Key Responsibilities :

Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python/Spark/Rust for data processing.
Build and optimize data transformations and aggregations for analytical workloads, including complex SQL with CTEs, window functions, and analyzing query execution/query planner.
Develop and manage workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow/Dagster/Prefect (or other orchestration tools).
Architect and maintain cloud-based data infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging services such as BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Google Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Compute Engine, and Cloud Functions for Data and Machine Learning workload.
Design data models and schemas that support OLAP analytics, reporting, and downstream machine learning use cases.
Implement data quality checks, validation frameworks, monitoring, and alerting for pipeline health and data integrity.
Ensure data systems comply with security standards, including ISO 27001, SOC Type 2, data privacy regulations like UU PDP, and internal information transfer policies.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data pipelines, data models, infrastructure, and operational procedures.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

Required Qualifications :
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform, or Software Engineering (data-focused roles).
Experience with analytics engineering tools such as dbt or Dataform is a plus.
Familiarity with FastAPI or other Python web frameworks for data service APIs is a plus.
Strong understanding of data governance, data security, and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001) is a plus.

Pillar Technology is a provider of advanced communications solutions and a trusted supplier of telecommunications equipment to government and law enforcement agencies across Indonesia.

The team currently comprises five engineers: backend, frontend, UI/UX, and two Android developers, working toward a production-ready release.

· 5+ years in Software Engineering, technical project management with a strong foundation in full stack development, or a closely related software role.

· Hands-on agile experience: sprint planning, backlog management, and running ceremonies for a small team.

· Experience owning a QA or acceptance testing process — writing test cases, logging bugs, and making release decisions.

· Disciplined approach to documentation — feature specs, release notes, service records, and configuration logs maintained consistently throughout the project lifecycle.

· Advanced written and spoken English — specifications are the foundation of the team's daily work (please do not apply if this requirement is not met).

Nice to Have

·       Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field — preferably from a top-tier Indonesian university (ITB, UI, ITS Surabaya, Telkom University, BINUS).

·       Background in or exposure to telecommunications, RF systems, GPS data, or geospatial platforms.

·       Familiarity with Figma or wireframing tools; exposure to SQL or data analysis.

·       Experience managing requirements for Android apps involving background services or data collection.

Key Responsibilities

Project Orchestration

· Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle, defining milestones and ensuring timely delivery.

Architectural decision making:

· Select and validate the tech stack decisions across BE, FE and Mobile. Ensure architecture is scalable, secure and maintainable.

· Define technical contracts (APIs / Databases) that allow our different platforms to communicate.

· Conduct high level code review and set engineering standards.

Feature Specification

· Write detailed PRDs defining feature behaviour in full: happy path, edge cases, error states, and explicit logic rules.

· Establish a Definition of Ready — every sprint item must have complete acceptance criteria before development begins.

· Collaborate with the UI/UX designer to validate wireframes against requirements before build starts.

Sprint & Delivery Management

· Own the prioritised product backlog and run full agile ceremonies across all five engineering streams.

· Manage the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from requirements through release and post-release monitoring — ensuring each phase has clear ownership and handoff criteria.

· Track sprint delivery, surface blockers early, and manage cross-stream dependencies between backend, frontend, and Android.

· Identify when a seemingly simple functional change carries significant engineering cost.

· Act as the first point of escalation (L2) for operational issues reported by end-clients — triage, document, and route to the appropriate engineer.

· Maintain comprehensive documentation across the full product lifecycle: system configurations, feature specs, release notes, and service records.

· Produce concise sprint summaries, milestone updates, and risk assessments.

·       A technically complex, mission-critical platform deployed by government and law enforcement clients.

·       High-visibility role with direct access to the CTO — your judgement will be trusted and acted upon.

·       Potential for long-term involvement as the platform scales toward full production deployment.

job_description:
Company Description


About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description


Get to Know the Team

The Lending team at Grab is focused on building safe, secure, and adaptable loan products that serve diverse user segments across Southeast Asia. Our mission is to guide financial inclusion and empower underbanked partners across the region. We design and operate critical platform components such as the Loan Management System, Repayments Engine, and Product Flow Orchestrator—powering seamless and reliable lending experiences at scale. Our work involves building large-scale distributed systems that impact millions of users, with a emphasis on reliability and scalability. Core engineering principles like idempotency, CAP theorem, and distributed agreement meaningfully contribute to how we architect and evolve our systems. At our core, we are driven by impact—creating financial solutions that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Get to Know the Role

You will design, build, and operate backend services that power end‑to‑end lending journeys – from origination and decisioning to servicing and repayments – across multiple markets.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, data and Ops teams to deliver high‑quality features, drive operational excellence, and mentor other engineers. This role is based in Indonesia with close collaboration across distributed teams in Asia.

Design and implement backend services that are robust, scalable, observable, and cost‑efficient, primarily in Golang and running on our Kubernetes‑based platform.

Qualifications

5+ years of backend engineering experience in a distributed systems environment, with experience with shipping and operating production services at scale.

Demonstrated experience for end‑to‑end delivery, including production quality, performance, and reliability.

Life at Grab

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology related field, or equivalent experience.

Work from anywhere: CSG has a global policy called "Flexibility First" that allows employees to work from wherever they feel most productive. Quantity Surveyor dan On-Site engineer bertanggung jawab untuk menghitung dan mengestimasi biaya proyek pembangunan, mulai dari material, tenaga kerja, hingga biaya lainnya. Estimasi Biaya Proyek:

Menghitung dan menyiapkan estimasi biaya proyek pembangunan, termasuk material, tenaga kerja, dan biaya operasional.

Mengumpulkan data dan mengevaluasi harga material dari vendor atau pemasok.

Mengoptimalkan biaya pembangunan tanpa mengurangi kualitas proyek.

Melakukan pengukuran kuantitas material dan pekerjaan yang dibutuhkan untuk proyek.

Menyiapkan Bill of Quantities (BoQ) atau Rencana Anggaran Biaya (RAB) yang detail.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi:

Menyiapkan laporan estimasi biaya, progress biaya, dan analisis variansi biaya.

Memastikan semua dokumen terkait biaya proyek terdokumentasi dengan baik.

Kegiatan di lapangan:

Mensupport dan mengatur tim yang berada di lapangan proyek.

Menyampaikan petunjuk teknis kepada seluruh tim pekerja.

Pendidikan: Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Sipil / Arsitektur

Kemampuan analitis dan matematis yang kuat.

Pengetahuan tentang material, metode konstruksi, dan standar desain.

Menguasai software seperti Microsoft Excel.

Kemampuan komunikasi dan team-work yang baik.

Detail-oriented dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.

Memiliki integritas tinggi, kejujuran, dan kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik.

job_description:
The Automation Engineer – Coding / Software Programming is accountable for developing, commissioning, and sustaining automation software and control systems for manufacturing equipment. The role ensures stable 24/7 operation, high productivity, and consistent quality by delivering robust PLC, HMI, motion, robot, vision, and machine data-logging solutions that enable effective production monitoring and root cause analysis.

The Automation Engineer – Mechanical Design is responsible for designing, developing, and sustaining mechanical systems for automated manufacturing equipment. The role ensures machines are robust, safe, maintainable, and capable of stable 24/7 operation by delivering sound mechanical design that supports automation software, process requirements, and production targets.




The Product Engineering (PE) is responsible for ensuring the technical integrity, manufacturability, and continuous enhancement of products throughout their lifecycle. This role bridges the gap between R&D/Design and the Production floor, ensuring that product specifications are translated into robust manufacturing processes. The PE focuses on optimizing product design for efficiency (DFM), managing Engineering Change Orders (ECO), and maintaining the highest quality standards to ensure cost-effective and stable 24/7 manufacturing.

18. Implement KEDA for event-driven autoscaling of Kubernetes workloads.
19. Set up and configure ASB for message queues and publish-subscribe topics to ensure reliable and scalable communication between applications.
20. API Management:

title: Technology Lead
job_description:
We are looking for an innovative and hands-on Technology Lead who is passionate about using AI and advanced technologies to create scalable, impactful solutions in education. This role requires strong technical expertise, leadership, and a problem-solving mindset to guide our technology and engineering efforts in delivering high-quality, mission-driven products.

We value adaptability, ownership, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you thrive on building systems, guiding technical decisions, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and solving complex challenges that change lives, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


Before You Apply
This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You’ll be expected to handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision. You must be able to stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your tasks, and deliver reliable outputs — even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback requires immediate turnaround.

If you’re seeking a role that will stretch your technical capacity, sharpen your problem-solving, and accelerate your growth, and you’re prepared to meet high expectations, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Leadership & Architecture: Lead the design and development of scalable, reliable technology platforms. Establish and maintain engineering standards, review technical implementations, and guide the adoption of AI, automation, and modern development practices to strengthen product capabilities.
Product Development & Innovation:Collaborate closely with product, design, and program teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. Contribute hands-on to the development of secure, user-friendly edtech platforms, experimenting with emerging technologies to improve product features, performance, and scalability from prototyping through deployment.
Team Leadership & Capability Building: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering organisation. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning, providing clear technical guidance, feedback, and professional development while ensuring effective resource allocation and on-time delivery.
Systems, Infrastructure & Integration:Oversee system infrastructure, architecture, and data integration to ensure reliability, security, and scalability. Support the implementation of DevOps practices, automation pipelines, and secure system design to maintain efficient and resilient platforms.

What We’re Looking For

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Leadership & Delivery Experience:4–5 years of experience working in software engineering or technical leadership roles in fast-paced environments, with experience contributing to scalable platform development. Experience in edtech, AI, or mission-driven sectors is highly valued.
Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, and React, along with experience using cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Solid background in data engineering, including ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehousing (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), and scalable data architectures. Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks, APIs, automation, and system integration is highly desirable.
Core Competencies: Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking with the ability to make sound technical decisions. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions.
Location & Mission Fit: Based in Bandung or willing to relocate, with a strong interest in applying technology to solve real-world education challenges.
Bonus (Nice to Have): Experience in edtech or NGO environments, familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, and knowledge of data privacy regulations and secure system design.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don’t expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you’re looking for a conventional technology role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re ready to build innovative solutions, lead technical initiatives, and create real-world impact through technology, we’d love to hear from you.

INDICO is Telkomsel's subsidiary focusing on creating values in developing Indonesia's digital ecosystem. As a digital ecosystem enabler, INDICO plays a strategic role both as a platform company and a holding company.

As a holding company, INDICO nurtures vertical businesses across sectors: Fita (health tech), Kuncie (edtech), Majamojo (game publishing), and Digital Food Ecosystem (agritech). By harnessing telecom's commercial and technological assets, INDICO aspires to create a new economy, empowering Indonesians and enabling businesses across sectors to advance Indonesia's digital economy.  

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes-if Mindset).

Infrastructure & Cloud Management 

Collaborate in designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure using services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, and VPC 
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt for consistent and repeatable deployments 
Assist in monitoring and optimizing AWS resource usage to ensure cost efficiency while maintaining performance standards 
Support implementation of AWS security best practices, including IAM policies, Secrets Manager, Security Hub, WAF, and GuardDuty, while learning compliance requirements with industry standards 

DevSecOps & CI/CD Pipeline Management 

Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deployment processes 
Integrate security controls into the DevOps lifecycle by working with tools like SonarQube, Checkmarx, or Snyk for static application security testing (SAST) and dependency scanning 
Learn and implement DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing) tools and processes to identify runtime vulnerabilities 
Use SonarQube to support coding standards enforcement, identify vulnerabilities, and contribute to high-quality code practices across development teams 

 Container Orchestration & Management

Manage containerized applications using Docker and work with orchestration platforms including Kubernetes (EKS), Amazon ECS, or Fargate 
Learn and apply container security best practices and vulnerability scanning for Docker images 
Contribute to designing and maintaining scalable microservices architectures using container technologies 

Monitoring & Observability 

Set up and manage monitoring tools such as AWS CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Opentelemetry, and ELK Stack for insights into system performance, availability, and security 
Create dashboards and alerting mechanisms for proactive incident response 
Support logging strategies and centralized log management for security and compliance requirements 

Collaboration & Continuous Learning 

Contribute to disaster recovery (DR) planning and backup strategies to ensure business continuity and data integrity 
Work closely with development, operations, and security teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of solutions 
Continuously learn and stay updated with DevSecOps best practices and emerging technologies

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field 
Equivalent professional experience and demonstrated skills will be considered 
Continuous learning mindset and willingness to pursue additional certifications 

Technical Expertise 

3+ years of experience with AWS cloud services and basic architecture principles 
2+ years of experience with Terraform and Terragrunt or willingness to learn infrastructure automation quickly 
Good understanding of Docker containerization and Kubernetes fundamentals 
Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar CI/CD tools and pipeline development 
Basic knowledge of SAST and DAST security testing concepts with eagerness to deepen expertise 
Familiarity with Grafana and AWS CloudWatch for monitoring and alerting 

Security & Compliance 

Understanding of cloud security principles and AWS security services 
Some exposure to security scanning tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, etc.) 
Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks and security best practices 
Interest in learning threat modeling and risk assessment methodologies  

Development & Scripting 

Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, PowerShell) 
Strong experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows 
Good understanding of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies  

Soft Skills 

Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn 
Good communication and collaboration abilities 
Ability to work effectively in team environments 
Strong desire for continuous learning and professional growth 

Preferred Qualifications 

AWS certifications (Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate, or willingness to pursue) 
Experience with additional monitoring tools (Prometheus, ELK Stack, DataDog) 
Interest in serverless architectures and AWS Lambda and ECS. 
Basic understanding of database concepts and optimization 
Experience with version control branching strategies and code review processes 
Previous exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments
